posts.title: The Ongoing Second American Civil War
posts.description: When the American Civil War ended, and the diseased nation lifted itself from the ashes for its Reconstruction era, do we suppose that the average historian believed this to be a one-off anomaly? Or, is it more probable that an astute historian would recognize the inequality, division, and greed to be inherent defects of the experimental nation? Let us suppose we do not know the answer.
